propositions: The citation section documentation does not specify that the upstream edge must be DIRECT, causing users to incorrectly assume transitive/indirect dependencies satisfy the requirement.
The verifier implementation det_citation._edge_verified already correctly enforces direct-edge-only checks with no recursion, but the shipped documentation does not reflect this constraint.
A ticket transitively depending on a cited ticket will have its citation marked as edge-unbacked and ground as normal (fail closed) with no warning, creating a silent footgun in practice.
The documentation must be updated to explicitly state that transitive/indirect dependencies do not count and only direct edges satisfy the citation requirement.
